constraints.shell: expanded sidebar with labels, persistent header, footer visible
constraints.panels: multi-column layouts allowed; graph side panels fixed on right

constraints.shell: compact sidebar with icon labels or hover tooltips

states.default: Four panels render coverage, progress, graph, and gaps with current API data.

states.error: Không thể kết nối đến gmind serve; retry action calls dashboard APIs again.
states.offline: Cached dashboard remains readable; write CTAs disabled with reason labels.

responsive.tablet: KPI cards wrap; panels stack as 2 rows
responsive.mobile: KPI cards and panels stack one per row; graph touch pan/zoom enabled

states.default: Portfolio, ART, Team, and PI Planning board data shown.

states.error: Không thể tải dữ liệu Board; retry action reloads board API.
states.offline: Drag and write actions queue locally; cards show Pending labels.

responsive.desktop: Horizontal Kanban with PI sandbox beside ROAM summary
responsive.tablet: Horizontal scroll columns with condensed cards
responsive.mobile: Vertical task card list replacing Kanban columns

states.loading: Skeleton evidence columns while aggregation completes.
states.insufficient_evidence: Approve disabled with specific missing evidence reason and Refresh evidence CTA.
states.empty: Không có yêu cầu phê duyệt nào đang chờ.
states.error: Lỗi kết nối đến dịch vụ CI/CD hoặc GitHub; approve disabled unless manual admin override is selected with audit reason.

responsive.mobile: Content first with Back to list button

states.default: Root node highlighted, graph edges and detail panel interactive.

states.empty: Không tìm thấy liên kết nào cho Beads ID này; CTA checks ID or opens search.
states.error: Lỗi truy vấn graph từ gmind trace; retry action reloads trace.
states.partial: Local graph shown while GitHub/FastCode enrichment badge indicates still loading.

responsive.mobile: Simplified tree view; detail opens full-screen

states.default: Task fields loaded, tabs interactive, editable fields save through API.
states.loading: Header fields and tab content skeletons.

states.saving: Edited field disabled and shows inline saving label until API response.
states.error: Task API failed; retry reloads task.
